proposal.title: Google Cloud bounded-keyword RAG with citations (first sketch)
proposal.body: Scope: a synthetic document collection uploaded by an operator. A Cloud Run ingestion job splits documents into keyword chunks and stores them with each source's permission list (ACL) in Firestore. Users sign in through Identity Platform to a Cloud Run web app. The app calls a Cloud Run RAG API that checks the sign-in token, searches with keywords only in documents the user may read, calls Gemini on Vertex AI and returns a cited answer. Cloud Logging keeps the audit trail. Assumptions: the region is not chosen yet; the Gemini model, quotas and regional availability are not verified; no account access is approved. These GCP components have no typed generator, so engineering is required. Local tests use a scripted model and synthetic identities.

data.label: Synthetic test user (browser)
data.description: Person using a browser. A client reference, not a provisioned resource.

data.label: Identity Platform
data.description: Signs users in with synthetic accounts (MFA proposed) and issues ID tokens. These carry the subject used for permission checks.

data.label: RAG web app
data.description: Authenticated chat UI. Gets a token from Identity Platform, calls the RAG API and shows the answer with its source citations.

data.label: RAG API (keyword retrieval + permission filter)
data.description: Checks the ID token and resolves the user's groups from the catalog. Runs bounded keyword search only over chunks whose ACL allows the user and re-checks the document revision. Sends the allowed passages to Gemini and returns a cited answer, or declines when no sources match. If the identity is unknown, it denies access.

data.label: Document & ACL catalog
data.description: Stores chunks, keyword terms, document revisions, source ACLs and user-to-group mappings. Not vector search.

data.label: Gemini model
data.description: Generates grounded answers from the passages it receives. The model version, regional availability and quota still need checking. Local tests use a scripted reply instead.

data.label: Synthetic document operator
data.description: Uploads synthetic documents and their explicit permission lists. A caller outside the provisioning scope.

data.label: Synthetic source documents
data.description: Private bucket for synthetic UTF-8 documents plus ACL metadata. Uniform bucket-level access; no public access.

data.label: Ingestion job
data.description: Reads new documents, checks their size, splits them into chunks and extracts keywords. Writes chunks and the source's ACL to the catalog using conditional, revision-aware writes.

data.label: Audit & monitoring
data.description: Records who asked, which document IDs were allowed or denied, and model latency and errors. It does not store prompt text by default.

requirementDrafts.rationale: If permissions are not enforced, users could see restricted content in answers or citations.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "keep all source permissions" and "identity enforcement".
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: an answer may only use and cite documents the signed-in user is allowed to read under the source permissions. Unknown identities are denied.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Citations let users check answers. Declining when no permitted source matches lowers the risk of made-up answers.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "Answer questions over a small synthetic document collection with citations."
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: every answer lists the source documents it used, and the system declines to answer when no permitted source matches.

requirementDrafts.rationale: Which Gemini models are available depends on the region, so the country decides where we can deploy.
requirementDrafts.basis: User: "Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access."
requirementDrafts.statement: Proposed: all data and model processing stay within a country the user names. The region is not yet selected.

response.message: The good news is that the design itself checks out. The emulation found no failures, and the whole flow is connected: sign-in, permission-checked keyword search, Gemini and cited answers. It's blocked because no generated code exists yet for these Google Cloud parts. The only typed Google Cloud contract we support is private object storage, and switching to it would shrink the scope, so we won't do that. The fix is product engineering work: native modules for Identity Platform, the Cloud Run web app and API, the Firestore catalog and the Vertex AI Gemini step. This exact project (revision 2, artifact 74f7326f…) can serve as the reproducer. Until those modules exist, nothing has tested real Gemini answers, Google Cloud permissions or a deployment. While that work is pending, let's settle the decision that's still open: which country must the synthetic documents and model processing stay in?
